title: 日本ダービーの後に・逃したのは誰

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After failing to seize first place in the Japanese Derby, King Halo bites her lip in frustration. She tries to put on a brave front despite the loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her mother calls to praise Special Week's performance and urge King Halo to give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before hanging up, her mother coldly advises her to come home before she disgraces herself even further. I watch tears well up in King Halo's eyes as she makes another vow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She promises to win the final round of the Classic Triple Crown tour and declares that her skill deserves to be recognized.
